<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/current_usage"}
#docs
One `current_usage` per subscription that has a metered item and an open usage window, newest first, at most 50 (`has_more` says more exist). `totals` sums each currency on its own; currencies are never added together or converted.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_projection` | `string` | no | `true` adds a projection to window end: the projected quantity is rated as the invoice rates it (a sum or count extends at the current rate, a level holds), plus any minimum-spend true-up. Null before 10% of the window has passed. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer id. |
| `data` | `array of object` | One entry per subscription. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `current_usage`. One of `current_usage`. |
| `data.subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The subscription's currency. |
| `data.as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | The instant the usage was read. |
| `data.window` | `object` | The usage window, or null when no invoice will bill usage. |
| `data.items` | `array of object` | The metered items. |
| `data.settled_charges` | `array of object` | Usage settled early (an item removed, a term reset). |
| `data.subtotal_minor` | `integer` | Sum of the item amounts and settled charges. |
| `data.tax_minor` | `integer` | Tax on the subtotal, inclusive tax included. |
| `data.tax_lines` | `array of object` | Exclusive tax by component. |
| `data.total_minor` | `integer` | Subtotal plus exclusive tax. |
| `data.projection` | `object` | Totals at window end, or null when not asked for or when less than 10% of the window has passed. |
| `data.discounts_applied` | `boolean` | Always false: coupons and credits are not applied here. |
| `data.trial` | `object` | Usage recorded during the trial, with no amount: no invoice bills it. Null outside a trial. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True if the customer has more than 50 metered subscriptions. |
| `totals` | `array of object` | One row per currency. Currencies are never summed together. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | List of current_usage |
| `400` | Unknown query parameter |
| `404` | No such customer |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/current_usage" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
